description: Controls of Adamantium UI: buttons, text, lists and trees, tabs, docking, the ribbon, a tree data grid, a property grid, color pickers, shapes, and an infinite canvas for drawing and node graphs.

Project templates for Adamantium UI. adamantium-app: a desktop application, a window in AUML markup and its view-model. adamantium-viewlib: a library of views with their view-models. adamantium-controllib: a library of templated controls styled in every theme.
